title: SieveScript/set: two scripts can end up active
description: sieve.rs:897 skips deactivating an active script the same call updated (e.g. rename), so update A + onSuccessActivateScript B leaves A and B active. RFC 9661 §2 at most one active script. (probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
close_reason: Fixed with regression tests (tests/submission_envelope.rs, sieve_activate.rs, vacation_singleton.rs, mdn_integration.rs).
